item.title: INC20000199 [resolved]
item.description:
Current status: We've implemented the fix for this issue and monitored the environment to confirm that service was restored. If you experience additional issues or have questions, please open a support case via Snowflake Community or the Support page in Snowsight.
Customer experience: Customers hosted in the specified regions may have been unable to access or use Snowflake services and features using Snowsight.
Workaround: There were no available workarounds for this issue.
Incident start time: 07:00 UTC September 04, 2026 Incident end time: 08:30 UTC September 04, 2026

item.title: INC20000188 [resolved]
item.description:
Current status: We've monitored the environment to confirm that service was restored. If you experience additional issues or have questions, please open a support case via Snowflake Community or the Support page in Snowsight.
Customer experience: Customers hosted in the specified region may have been unable to access or use multiple core Snowflake services and features, including signing in to Snowsight, executing queries, loading and unloading data, and using Snowpark Container Services. Some customers may have also experienced delays with Snowpipe Streaming ingestion and elevated error rates when accessing Snowsight.

item.title: INC20000150 [identified]
item.description:
Current status: We have taken additional steps to preserve available compute resources in the specified region, including adjusting compute pool scaling to reduce non-essential resource consumption. We continue to prioritize available resources for Business Critical Edition accounts, and non-essential maintenance operations in the specified region remain paused. The software update to enable additional compute resources for Snowpark Container Services in the specified region is in the testing and validation stage. We continue to be in contact with our third-party cloud platform, and we'll provide another update by 00:00 UTC September 8, 2026.
